name: Liquid Glass Logo
description: A droplet becomes a glass icon, then the glass and waves disappear, leaving the original logo on the background. The logo stays at its normal size on black. Supports custom SVG, PNG and other image logos.

controls.name: text
controls.label: Wordmark
controls.description: Text revealed by the expanding lens. Supports custom fonts and Unicode text.

controls.name: ending
controls.label: Finish on
controls.description: Play the complete wordmark reveal or finish on the original logo alone. The glass disappears in both modes.

controls.name: logoSize
controls.label: Tile size (px)
controls.description: Glass tile edge in pixels. The logo, lens and wordmark shrink together to fit the container.

controls.name: logoScale
controls.label: Logo scale
controls.description: Logo width or height as a fraction of the plate edge.

controls.name: finalLogoScale
controls.label: Final logo scale
controls.description: Resting logo scale. At 1, the logo holds its normal size while the glass fades. Applies to Logo only.

controls.name: tile
controls.label: Icon plate
controls.description: Lay the logo on a rounded icon plate.

controls.name: fontSize
controls.label: Font size (px)
controls.description: Size of the wordmark.

controls.name: fontWeight
controls.label: Font weight
controls.description: Weight of the wordmark font.

controls.name: letterSpacing
controls.label: Letter spacing (em)
controls.description: Tracking of the wordmark.

controls.name: markGap
controls.label: Mark gap (em)
controls.description: Space between the mark and the wordmark.

controls.name: theme
controls.label: Theme
controls.description: Light or dark page, plate and logo colors. Colors passed explicitly override the theme.

controls.name: logoRelief
controls.label: Logo relief
controls.description: Rounded shading on the recolored logo. At 0 the logo is flat in its color; at 1 it has full relief. Original colors are always flat.

controls.name: logoColor
controls.label: Logo color
controls.description: Recolors the logo silhouette. Pass "original" to keep the image colors.

controls.name: textColor
controls.label: Text color
controls.description: Color of the wordmark and its mark.

controls.name: tileColor
controls.label: Plate color
controls.description: Dark surface beneath the logo lens.

controls.name: background
controls.label: Background
controls.description: Container background. Use transparent to sit over your own surface.

controls.name: depth
controls.label: Optical depth
controls.description: Optical depth of the glass in tile edges. Deeper glass bends and magnifies the image further.

controls.name: dispersion
controls.label: Dispersion
controls.description: Separation between wavelengths at the glass bevels and wordmark edges.

controls.name: relief
controls.label: Double bevel
controls.description: Intensity of the inset glass back face, its separate refracted image and the split highlights in the lower-right corner.

controls.name: caustics
controls.label: Caustics
controls.description: Light concentrated onto the artwork at the lens shoulder.

controls.name: highlights
controls.label: Highlights
controls.description: Brightness of the glass contours and reflected studio lights.

controls.name: bloom
controls.label: Light diffusion
controls.description: Soft light around the glass and bright artwork edges. Keeps the white of the artwork from being overexposed.

controls.name: dropSize
controls.label: Drop size
controls.description: Initial size of the expanding wordmark lens, relative to the tile edge.

controls.name: dropStrength
controls.label: Drop strength
controls.description: Curvature of the optical surface: stronger lenses pull the image further into their edges.

controls.name: echoTint
controls.label: Echo plate tint
controls.description: How much the faint line just outside the rim takes the plate color. At 0 it keeps its cool blue glint; at 1 it matches the plate and stays quiet on dark pages.

controls.name: innerWallFocus
controls.label: Inner wall focus
controls.description: At 0 the inner glass wall is drawn whole. At 1 it keeps to bright arcs at the upper-left and lower-right corners, which reads cleaner on a light theme.

controls.name: decay
controls.label: Ring decay (s)
controls.description: Time for the secondary lens reflections to fade.

controls.name: speed
controls.label: Speed
controls.description: Playback rate of the glass sequence. At 1, the logo reveal lasts 1.8 seconds; the optional wordmark sequence lasts 3.3 seconds.

controls.name: loop
controls.label: Loop
controls.description: Restart after the finished artwork has held for Loop delay.

controls.name: loopDelay
controls.label: Loop delay (s)
controls.description: Seconds the finished artwork holds before the sequence restarts.

controls.name: paused
controls.label: Paused
controls.description: Hold the current frame.
